scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @adb/api" "npm run dev -w @adb/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @adb/api && npm run build -w @adb/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @adb/api && npm run test -w @adb/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
